content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I have a question about configuring the [product_name] operator panel. I purchased a starter kit: [product_name] Starter Kit [article_no]. Is it possible to set up custom screens on this panel, such as showing a piece counter, or is it just an extension of the existing display? I searched for a configuration tool but couldn't find anything useful. Thanks in advance. [user_name]

Hi, there isn't a tool specifically for programming the display. You should use the new feature found under File > message text settings in the menu. For further details about the display and how to use it, I recommend checking the application examples related to [product_name]. Look at the section covering the display. Regards,
Thank you, I found this shortly after posting.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unsure about setting up custom screens on the [product_name] panel included in the starter kit, particularly with [article_no]. The main usability issue identified was the lack of clear documentation or a dedicated configuration tool, leading to confusion over the panel’s capability to go beyond simply extending the main display. Suggestions focused on using message text settings within the menu, highlighting that this feature is not easy to find.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects an intuitive tool or straightforward method for creating custom screens on the [product_name] panel, enabling specific displays such as a piece counter.
